$comment: Selection policy of the full Entry Point (scripts/test-runner/run ci = validation by change, full = integral validation). Read by scripts/test-runner/selection.ts. Changing this file widens validation by change to every check. Approved in ADOPTION-PLAN.md.

runtimeDependents.$comment: Composition tests reach the built entrypoints as processes (dist/src/entrypoints/*), an edge the import graph cannot see: they depend on every source file.

checks.$comment: Reads GLOSSARY.md's _Avoid_ lines (shared configuration: a change to them widens validation).
npm audit with the npm pinned in package.json engines; needs the registry. Integral validation runs it every night, so a new advisory against an unchanged lockfile is caught by the next night.
Unit and Integration levels are declared per file in stage S3 of ADOPTION-PLAN.md; until then this is the whole regression suite.

checks.protectionBetweenRuns: validation by change runs every affected test file (changed files, their importers, and every composition test when any source changes)
checks.residualRisk: the real-disk sandbox tests (FACTORY_SANDBOX_TEST_ROOT) and the full-only files in test/tiers.json run only here; a break they alone see stays unseen until the next night

checks.protectionBetweenRuns: validation by change runs the affected tests in their declared order
checks.residualRisk: an order dependence between tests stays unseen until the next night
